name: Peter Thiel
current_role: Chairman of Palantir Technologies; co-founder of Founders Fund
summary: Peter Thiel is a venture capitalist and the central figure of the PayPal Mafia. He co-founded Confinity in 1998, became CEO of PayPal after its merger with Elon Musk's X.com, co-founded Palantir in 2003 and Founders Fund in 2005, and was Facebook's first outside investor and a board member from 2005 to 2022. A major Republican donor, he gave $1.25 million to Trump's 2016 campaign and $15 million to a super PAC backing his former employee and protégé JD Vance's 2022 Senate run.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: After Confinity merged with Musk's X.com in 2000, the board replaced Musk as CEO with Thiel in late 2000 while Musk was away on his honeymoon. Fortune later reported Musk had made up with the "mutineers."

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: Thiel's Founders Fund invested $20 million in SpaceX in 2008, its first institutional backer, a stake that paid off in SpaceX's June 2026 IPO; Thiel had declined to invest in Tesla. Founders Fund also backed the Boring Company and Neuralink.
